name: Custom Screen
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Your own deck-screen panels from a text file: readouts, 4-deck rekordbox waveforms and FlowVJ's status.
description: Up to four click-through panels on the deck screen, each holding the readouts you pick: title, artist, key, BPM, BPMs that fit, pitch move, phrase meter from rekordbox's grid, time left, stems, clock, key wheels, 4-deck rekordbox waveforms, FlowVJ status with tap buttons, and now the 4-deck phase strip and dead-air warnings (LOAD NEXT, ENDING, QUIET, DEAD AIR), so 4-Deck Phase Strip and Dead-Air Guard can be switched off and their screen space goes to other mods. The layout comes from layout.txt on the USB. No audio, tempo, key, control or library changes.
